title: Pesticides
description: Adds pesticides to the game to make your farming experience worse ! (or to poison your friends)
body:
# Pesticides™

Did you ever want to make your minecraft farming experience worse ? No ? Uhhh... not my problem.
Anyway, we at Pesticides™ have created a mod to revolutionise your farming experience !

We know you **always** wanted to put pretty pesticides on your crops, and that's why we're here.
Using the power of `Pesticide Containers` and `Faucets` you can put pesticides onto them.

Say goodbye to bugs and say hello to a new era in agriculture !

---

Anyway enough of this. What does this mod actually has to offer ?

## Pesticides

This is the main focus of this mod.
Pesticides allow you to make your crops grow faster, up to 645% faster !

But pesticides also have unique effects. You can gain them either by being poisoned or by drinking pesticides.

<details>
<summary>The different pesticides types</summary>
6 pesticides are added into the game:

| Name | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Ampropylfos **(cheapest)** | [Instant Damage](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Instant_Damage) |
| Terpinolene | Freezing |
| Glyphosate | Drowning |
| Atrazine | [Poison](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Poison) |
| Endosulfan | Burning |
| Afidopyropen **(most expensive)** | [Wither](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Wither_(effect)) |
</details>

Faucets **are the main block**. They are what's used to **dispense pesticides onto your crops**.
There are 4 types of faucets:
- Copper
- Iron
- Diamond
- Netherite (congrats if you actually do this one)

Each types has its own chance to infect the farmland under the crop, and optionally a filter can be put in it to decrease this.

## Farmland infection

Farmlands have a small chance to get infected.
They will slowly turn green over 30 minutes and infect the crops on top of them and stop their growing process entirely.

## Food poisoning

They are 2 ways for food to get infected:
- Like stated above if a crop has fully grown and the farmland got infected, the given food will get infected with the pesticide's effects
- But you can also mix in any crafting grid a `Pesticide Container` and some food to infect it silently. (This cannot be seen BUT infected food cannot be stacked with regular food). This works with modded food too.

## Is this it ?

No but I did not explain everything here.
If you want to learn more you can look on the [mod's wiki](https://github.com/Geming400/pesticide-mod/wiki) !

# Did this not convice you yet ?

Fear not player ! We, at Pesticides™ have gotten feedbacks from some of our fellow customers !

> *"I was able to take amazing screenshots of people dying after drinking pesticides, thanks Geming400."* - Tagorier, 2026

> *"10/10 for the mod. However my doctor has questions for Geming400."* - Raycor666, 2026

> *"A mod that's disturbingly realistic, especially when it comes to the downside of pesticides.*" - Currenttick, 2026

# Why did you make this

This mod actually was made to mess around in a server with some friends, so **do not expect this to be maintained** !

Though, you can always [create an issue](https://github.com/Geming400/pesticide-mod/issues) and i'll probably still take a look at it.
